subject: History
description: Founders, dynasties, Krishnadeva Raya, Hampi, Talikota battle

questions.stem: The Vijayanagara empire was founded in 1336 CE by:
questions.explanation: VIJAYANAGARA empire — founded 1336 CE by HARIHARA I + BUKKA RAYA I (Sangama brothers; legend: blessed by Vidyaranya, the Shringeri Math saint). Capital: VIJAYANAGARA / HAMPI on Tungabhadra (Karnataka). Four DYNASTIES: SANGAMA (1336-1485), SALUVA (1485-1505), TULUVA (1505-1570 — including KRISHNADEVA RAYA, the greatest), ARAVIDU (1570-1646). Originally founded as a Hindu bulwark against Bahmani / Delhi sultanates expansion southward. Distractor 1 — Krishnadeva Raya was Tuluva dynasty (1509-29).
questions.subject: History

questions.stem: KRISHNADEVA RAYA (greatest Vijayanagara emperor) belonged to which dynasty?
questions.explanation: KRISHNADEVA RAYA (r. 1509-1529 CE) — TULUVA dynasty (3rd of 4). Considered greatest Vijayanagara emperor. Wrote AMUKTAMALYADA (Telugu epic) + JAMBAVATI KALYANAM (Sanskrit). Patronised the ASHTADIGGAJAS — '8 elephants' (8 great Telugu poets in his court): ALLASANI PEDDANA (= 'Andhra Kavita Pitamaha'), Nandi Timmana, Madayyagari Mallana, Dhurjati, Ayyalaraju Ramabhadra, Pingali Surana, Ramaraja Bhushana (Bhattumurti), Tenali Ramakrishna. Defeated GAJAPATI of Odisha. Built ULIRA Singh Sahib temple, Vittala temple at Hampi. Visited by PORTUGUESE traveller Domingo Paes.

questions.stem: The BATTLE OF TALIKOTA (1565), which led to Vijayanagara's downfall, was fought against:
questions.explanation: BATTLE OF TALIKOTA (also called RAKSHASA-TANGADI / BANNIHATTI; 23 Jan 1565 CE) — DECCAN SULTANATES alliance vs Vijayanagara. Five Deccan sultanates briefly UNITED: Bijapur (Adil Shah) + Ahmadnagar (Nizam Shah) + Bidar (Barid Shah) + Golconda (Qutb Shah). Berar stayed neutral. Vijayanagara army led by RAMA RAYA (Aravidu, regent of TULUVA emperor Sadasiva) — defeated, captured + beheaded. CAPITAL HAMPI sacked + ruined for 5 months. Empire continued in reduced form under Aravidu dynasty for ~80 more years (Penukonda + Chandragiri capitals) but never recovered.

questions.stem: Vijayanagara's capital city, HAMPI, is located on the banks of which river?
questions.explanation: HAMPI — on the south bank of TUNGABHADRA river (a major tributary of Krishna), in Bellary district of KARNATAKA. UNESCO WORLD HERITAGE SITE (1986). Spread over ~25 sq km. Major monuments: VIRUPAKSHA TEMPLE (Pampavati's), VITTALA TEMPLE with stone-chariot + musical pillars, HAZARA RAMA temple, KRISHNA temple, LOTUS MAHAL, ELEPHANT STABLES, QUEEN'S BATH, MAHANAVAMI DIBBA. Visited + described by foreign travellers: Abdur Razzak (Persian, 1443), Domingo Paes (Portuguese, 1520-22), Fernao Nuniz (Portuguese, 1535-37), Nicolo Conti (Italian, 1420). All called it the GRANDEST + RICHEST CITY of the time.

questions.stem: The Vijayanagara military was famous for its use of:

options.option_text: Naval warships in the Arabian Sea
Camel cavalry from the desert nomads

questions.explanation: Vijayanagara army components: (1) ELEPHANTS — psychological terror + breaking enemy lines. (2) CAVALRY — imported Arabian + Persian horses (via Portuguese in Goa, after 1510); cavalry critical for victories. (3) INFANTRY (foot soldiers, archers, swordsmen). (4) ARTILLERY / FIREARMS — guns + cannons, often supplied / operated by PORTUGUESE in alliance (esp. under Krishnadeva Raya). NAYANKARA SYSTEM — chiefs (NAYAKAS) granted land (AMARAM) in return for military service + revenue collection. Distractor 1 — Vijayanagara had limited naval forces.

questions.stem: Vijayanagara's official COURT LANGUAGE for literature was largely:

options.option_text: Sanskrit, classical only with no other
Portuguese, after Goa came under Portugal

questions.explanation: Vijayanagara — multilingual but TELUGU rose to prominence, especially under KRISHNADEVA RAYA (himself a Telugu poet — 'Andhra Bhoja'). Often called the GOLDEN AGE OF TELUGU LITERATURE. Also patronised KANNADA (Kumara Vyasa, Sarvajna), TAMIL (Saiva + Vaishnava texts), SANSKRIT (philosophy, religious). ASHTADIGGAJAS = 8 great TELUGU poets in Krishnadeva Raya's court. Notable works: 'AMUKTAMALYADA' (by emperor himself), 'MANUCHARITRAMU' (Allasani Peddana). Distractor 4 — Portuguese were a TRADING partner via Goa, not Vijayanagara's language.

questions.stem: MAHANAVAMI festival, splendidly celebrated at Vijayanagara each year, marked the:

options.option_text: Autumn harvest at end of monsoon
Spring festival of colours called Holi

questions.explanation: MAHANAVAMI = '9-night' = NAVARATRI festival (devoted to goddess Durga + Mother goddess). Most important state festival of Vijayanagara, lasting 9 days; ended on Vijaya Dashami (10th day = Dussehra). Celebrated at the MAHANAVAMI DIBBA (a stone platform at Hampi, still visible) — emperor reviewed troops, received tribute, watched dance + music. Foreign travellers like Abdur Razzak + Paes wrote elaborate accounts of MAHANAVAMI. Continued tradition: MYSORE DASARA (Wodeyars who succeeded Vijayanagara in part of the territory adopted similar grand celebrations). Distractor 4 — Holi is north Indian, not a southern festival emphasised.
